about.title: Engineering that ships and scales
paragraphs: I'm a backend-leaning full-stack engineer based in Barcelona. At EXTE I own features end to end — from secure REST APIs and microservices to the Vue.js dashboards that sit on top of them — with a strong bias toward real business impact, clean code and maintainable systems.

My day-to-day mixes PHP (Symfony, Yii2), Python (FastAPI) and geospatial data, integrating external platforms and turning slow manual processes into automated, observable systems. I'm now specializing in Machine Learning through an MSc in AI, bringing applied ML, NLP and MLOps into my engineering toolkit.

items.summary: DOOH advertising platform. End-to-end ownership across backend services and the Vue.js products on top of them.
highlights: Engineered a campaign planning microservice with agency-specific business rules and geospatial proximity calculations (POI + screen radius), cutting planning time from several days to minutes and removing manual coordination bottlenecks.
Built inventory sync pipelines integrating external DOOH platforms (Broadsign, VIOOH, Hivestack) via REST APIs, keeping screen and availability data consistent in real time.

Developed full-stack dashboards (Vue.js + Elasticsearch) with an integrated map layer (MBTiles + Martin tile server + Mapbox/MapLibre) for real-time inventory visualization, used by agency clients and internal teams.
Designed secure REST APIs (OAuth2, JWT, OWASP) and built CRUD services across monolithic and microservice architectures (Symfony, Yii2, MariaDB, Docker).
Implemented GitLab CI/CD pipelines with automated testing and staged deployments, improving release stability; contributed reusable components to the internal Vue.js UI library.

items.summary: Hands-on manufacturing role that built the teamwork, accountability and work ethic I apply to every engineering project.
highlights: Delivered precise, deadline-driven work in a high-accountability environment — later the seed of the Cutting Calculator tool I built to automate the team's bar-cutting math.

featured.name: DOOH Campaign & Inventory Planner
featured.description: Planning microservice and full-stack dashboard for digital out-of-home campaigns. Agency-specific business rules plus POI + screen-radius geospatial calculations turn a multi-day manual process into a few minutes, with real-time inventory on an interactive map.

featured.name: Expense Optimizer
featured.description: Full-stack app that parses statements from multiple banks, auto-categorizes expenses, detects anomalies and generates intelligent summaries with a local LLM. Multi-bank, CSV/Excel, bilingual (EN/ES).

featured.description: Web app that automates bar-cutting calculations for aluminum carpentry, cutting human error and speeding up the shop floor — built for the team I used to work with at MAFAC.
featured.impact: Eliminates manual cutting math and rework
